title: The Open Coffin
text: An open coffin lies in the barrow's mouth, lined with rotten velvet. A sweet, patient voice inside says that the first to lie in it will have its treasure. All along it has been calling softly to the frailest of you, by name.

options.label: The frailest lies down in it, wanting to answer.

outcomes.text: The lid shuts, then opens. They come out with a dead king's ring and something of the dark behind their eyes.
The lid shuts and stays shut a while. When it opens, they are not all the way back.

options.label: The shrewdest prises out the lining to take the treasure without lying down.

outcomes.text: Gold is sewn into the silk. The voice goes quiet with offense.

options.label: Close the lid and nail it shut; no one answers that voice.

outcomes.text: As you leave, something knocks from inside, patient and polite.
